create_eval_runner: create an EvalRunner instance with a dataloader, EvalUnit, and optional callbacks list
run_eval_runner: run the EvalRunner to evaluate a model using TorchTNT's evaluate function
configure_eval_runner_callbacks: configure an EvalRunner with a list of TorchTNT callbacks for evaluation hooks
set_max_steps_per_epoch: set the max_steps_per_epoch parameter on EvalRunner to limit evaluation steps per epoch
review_eval_runner_save_load_state: review the EvalRunner save_state and load_state stub methods for preemption checkpointing
